description:
Surface the AI-engine prompts where competitor domains were URL-cited in the site's audit history (MCP runs on its domain included) but the site was NOT — for one competitor, or all of them at once.

Billing: 5¢ per call — one run whether it covers one competitor or all. Not billed when the site_id or competitor_domain is rejected, the scan fails, or the window has no answered checks (total_prompts_scanned 0).

When to call: 'what is <competitor> cited on that we're not', 'which competitors beat us in AI answers'. For all competitors, omit competitor_domain rather than calling once each.

Inputs: site_id (from list_sites); competitor_domain — optional, one of the site's competitor_domains; window_days — optional, default 30 (7–365).

Returns with competitor_domain: { rows: [{prompt, competitor_url, engines_competitor_cited_on, last_cited_at, user_brand_mentioned, leverage, winnable, flags?}], leverage_legend, total_prompts_scanned, competitor_domain, window_days, generated_at, charged_cents }.
Without it: { competitors: [{competitor_domain, prompts_won, high_leverage, pure_loss, engines}] by prompts_won, rows: [{prompt, competitors_cited, competitor_count, winning_urls: [{competitor_domain, url}], engines_competitor_cited_on, last_cited_at, user_brand_mentioned, leverage, winnable, flags?}] winnable first, then widest losses, leverage_legend, competitor_domains, total_prompts_scanned, window_days, generated_at, charged_cents }.
competitor_url / winning_urls: the competitor page cited (most recent), the page to beat. leverage: high_leverage = brand named but not URL-cited (closest gap), pure_loss = not named either (needs content and mentions first); leverage_legend explains. winnable false, with flags dated (a past year) or other_brands_head_to_head (X vs Y without the brand): usually not worth a fix. A competitor_domain not on the site returns competitor_not_on_site with valid_competitor_domains.

Example: { site_id: "...", competitor_domain: "asana.com" } — or { site_id: "..." } for all competitors.

competitor_domain.description: One of the site's competitor_domains (see list_sites). Omit to analyze every competitor on the site in one 5¢ run.

name: mine_competitor_prompts
title: Find prompts where competitors are winning citations and you're not
